company.name: Adani Ports and SEZ
company.tag: Runs ports that load and unload ships, plus trains, trucks, warehouses and tugboats that move the cargo on
products: Container terminals (loading and unloading boxes from ships)
Coal, iron ore and other loose cargo handling
Liquid cargo tank farms and gas terminals (LNG and LPG)
Ports in Israel, Tanzania, Sri Lanka and Australia
Trains, trucks and inland container depots
Warehouses, grain silos and logistics parks
sources: Adani Ports and SEZ investor relations
aliases: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited
Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd
company.productNote: Ports, logistics and marine services named in Adani Ports and SEZ's 2025–26 integrated annual report. Adani Enterprises, which once owned the ports business, is a separate listed company with its own page. Pictures are annual-report photographs.
